craft_notes: Sthāyin: ladder to Māyā-melt. Rows: lifespans then melt. Read aloud: rising then dissolving.

lines: But the Throat-lord's own life — the sheath-Rudras' day, that long the night;
their life — Gloaming's day, that long alone the night;
and in her the all in Māyā melts away entire.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yat tu śrīkaṇṭhanāthasya svam āyuḥ tat kañcukavāsināṃ rudrāṇāṃ dinaṃ tāvatī rajanī teṣāṃ yad āyuḥ tat gahaneśadinaṃ tāvatī eva kṣapā tasyāṃ ca samastam eva māyāyāṃ vilīyate
